svg.title: How work reaches a core: ranges, slices, pulls, choices
svg.text: How work reaches a core: only when the core asks
every thread of a frame is a number the frame's thread hands to the core that asks for one
the cut: what a thread is
a layer's triangle blocks (32 triangles each)
a count range: 4 blocks on Sponza (set by the scene); counted, then placed
a row of the frame: 60 tiles of 32 x 32 pixels
slice 1's records, in order of weight: a record is a tile thread

svg.text: number = slice x 32 + place (TR_NUMBER); a tile past the weight
heavy is cut into bands of its rows, a record each
a pull: the core asks, its port answers
CPUs and mover B; the thread
the count pull: whoever asks gets the next range (logged);
the place pull replays the log; the tile pull asks dp_choose
the tile pull's choice (the option policy): which slice the core that asks gets next
